content: Context rot: Chroma tested 18 frontier models — all degrade as input length grows; lost-in-the-middle effect; agents accumulate exploration noise that degrades subsequent output; long context also destabilizes safety refusals (arXiv 2512.02445). Mitigations: isolate search into subagents with own windows, return precise ranges not whole files, discard exploration traces, compact diffs, proactive compaction, retrieval over stuffing. Not fixable by bigger windows or better prompts alone.
